notes.title: Final release and update 1.58!
notes.notes:
Final version released!

Now you can play and have fun with a fine version with Boss Rush game mode and simplified chinese language added.

Debugged since last version:

- Chinese language and debug;
- Boss Rush balanced and debug;
- Minor bug fixed.


In the next few weeks a new patch to improve all systems.

Enjoy,

Mean Team Studio staff

notes.title: Final release launch!
notes.notes:
Finally, after 18 months we are ready to launch the final version of Die Bloody Nazi Die! on SEPTEMBER 26th.
This is our very first project. So be kind and feel free to send us your tip, proposal, screen, or advice! We are here for our players, always!
thanks from Mean Team Studio and Decimo Studio

notes.title: Update #01
#4 Ready for the first update!
notes.notes:
We are working to provide a juicy update within few days! So be patient and you will not regret it.

Die Bloody Nazi Die! will be enhanced by balanced environmental items drop, tuned mechanics, many bugs fixed and some new features.

We are going to add in-game controller support too.

Thank you for feedback and input received so far!

Stay tuned!
